physics_and_numerics.fields: Fresh curvature-consistent cell centres/normals/areas, original SIgravity/thermal/renormalization, full-donor cooler-first tiled reflection and freshBB emission; CK04originalCPU radiance/LD. Same finite field method as m016, including original LDprefix/visibility conventions.
physics_and_numerics.observer_edges: E=(1-s)a+s b; C=E+lambda(s)(c-E); v=(1-t)C+t c. Solve original implicit limb/shadow along each Gaussian slice. Jacobian abs(det(a,b,c))*(1-t)*(1-lambda)^2/abs(v)^3; lambda-prime term cancels. Default8sliceGauss nodes and order4interior quadrature in profiles. Positive weights, original source-cone membership of contour/interior nodes checked.
physics_and_numerics.finite_chords: Prescribed additional junction refinement plus explicitly counted singular-fan whole-source-leaf refinement. Remove all earlier fragments from a singular source before reintegration to avoid overlap/lost crescent. Exact zero endpoints retained; exact duplicate/zero-measure fragments alone removed. Finite chords and empirical topology checks persist; no continuous-boundary certificate.
physics_and_numerics.method_vs_parity: Reference uses unchanged originalCPU equations on the new finite geometry/integration. This differs from original faceted whole-curve synthesis. Both implementations must have identical packet hashes/traces. Preceding chord comparison is a deliberate numerical method control, not implementation parity.
physics_and_numerics.domain_and_resources: Existing circular detached unspotted/nonpulsating q[.5,2],spin[.5,1.5],inner radius1e-6..0.25; field/common levels0-3 and40000faces/starcap;1-8bands,1-128phases.
